newsitem.title: ST VINCENT: CRICKET-JAYASURIYA NEARS CENTURY AGAINST WEST INDIES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-JAYASURIYA NEARS CENTURY AGAINST WEST INDIES.

text.p: Sri Lanka opener Sanath Jayasuriya batted cautiously as he neared a century during the rain-hit morning session on the second day of the second test against West Indies on Saturday.
By lunch Jayasuriya was on 90 as Sri Lanka took their score to 185 for four, a lead of 38, after resuming at their overnight 157 for three.
West Indies were dismissed for 147 in their first innings.

A total of 55 minutes was lost through rain shortly after the start and when play was resumed the visitors lost the wicket of captain Arjuna Ranatunga, edging fast bowler Courtney Walsh to Brian Lara at first slip.
At the interval, sanjeeva ranatunga was the other not out batsman on one.
